cluster_summary: This cluster includes 37 CVEs in XWiki where user-controlled input is embedded into template outputs (wiki syntax, HTML, URLs, scripts) without proper escaping or context-aware handling. The root causes vary: missing HTML escaping, missing wiki syntax escaping, missing URL encoding, missing validation, incomplete escaping functions, or improper use of rendering macros. All lead to injection of wiki macros, Velocity, Groovy, or HTML/JavaScript with server-side privileges.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled markup, HTML fragments, rich text, comments, DOM nodes, style blocks, attributes, or URI values into HTML cleaners, SafeHtml validators, DOM sanitizers, rich-text renderers, or browser-rendered sanitized output. Report code paths where the active sanitizer policy does not allowlist dangerous elements, attributes, URI schemes, DOM child nodes, comments, or malformed inputs before rendering. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 2 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should activate the restrictive sanitizer for the relevant mode, enforce element/attribute/URI allowlists after parsing, and add regression tests for the bypass form.

mechanism.missing_guard: the active sanitizer policy does not allowlist dangerous elements, attributes, URI schemes, DOM child nodes, comments, or malformed inputs before rendering
mechanism.name: HTML sanitizer policy gap or inactive allowlist
mechanism.sink_shape: HTML cleaners, SafeHtml validators, DOM sanitizers, rich-text renderers, or browser-rendered sanitized output
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled markup, HTML fragments, rich text, comments, DOM nodes, style blocks, attributes, or URI values
mechanism.typical_fix: activate the restrictive sanitizer for the relevant mode, enforce element/attribute/URI allowlists after parsing, and add regression tests for the bypass form

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply $escapetool.xml() to all user-controlled values before outputting them in an HTML context.
sub_patterns.name: Missing HTML/XML escaping
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled values are embedded directly into HTML output or attributes without escaping, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Use HTMLCleaner in restricted mode to remove dangerous tags and attributes from the external HTML content.
sub_patterns.name: Unsanitized external HTML in macro output
sub_patterns.root_cause: RSS feed item descriptions are passed directly to a raw HTML rendering sink without sanitization, assuming they are safe.
